These '''quarters''' were used by the [[Governor/Legends|governor]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bandomeer/Legends|Bandomeer]]. It was located within [[Bandor (city)|Bandor]]. The quarters featured a receiving room and guest quarters. In [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]], when [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] arrived on Bandomeer in response to a request from the Bandomeer government asking for a "Guardian of the Peace", he was housed in one of the quarters' guest chamber, along with [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]].
